title: NA60007: Composites For Marine Structures
text:
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Introduction to composite materials-, Marine applications of composites;
Processing of FRP composites; Micromechanical analysis of composite strength
and stiffness; Analysis of unidirectional lamina and laminated composite;
Analytical methods of analysis of laminated beams and plates; Finite element
analysis of composite structure; Hygrothermal effects in laminates; Failure
theories and laminate strength; Design of FRP composite; Case studies; Mine
countermeasure vessels, High performance weight-critical hulls, underwater
vehicle.
